caseName: Consolidated Rock Products Co. v. City of Los Angeles
caseNameFull: CONSOLIDATED ROCK PRODUCTS CO. Et Al. v. CITY OF LOS ANGELES
attorneys: Howard C. Westwood for appellants., Roger Arnebergh and Bourke Jones for appellee.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeal is dismissed for want of a substantial federal question.

Mr. Justice Douglas and Mr. Justice Harlan are of the opinion that probable jurisdiction should be noted.
